short_title: No intake for merges the factory did not produce
integrity_anchor: .factory/STATE.md (develop_head) — spec_process tier, "the ratchet's referent"; secondarily "the ratchet / convergence gate definition (PASS must require committed artifacts)", since a non-factory merge carries a green CI check that certifies nothing about the pipeline's assurance
quick_win_disqualification: Disqualified by rule — integrity=true is a hard exclusion from the safe lane (finding-004), and the nature is design-architectural with four competing fix shapes, not a bounded mechanical change.
rationale: Rubric advances: "(self-referential) a pilot-derived engine process-gap or meta finding that hardens the factory's own gates/convergence — on-mission, not self-reference" and "tightens an existing gate / removes a drift surface". Pilot-derived against BOHICA-LABS/prism with git evidence: factory-artifacts 7ce4c071 records develop_head 85f30ea7f while develop is 561d8bac (561d8bac external PR #287, daac70dc maintainer out-of-band), and PRs #287/#288/#291/#292 carry zero story or BC references yet merge green. It names the drift surface exactly: the pointer is advanced only by the state-manager post-merge burst, so any merge without a story has no writer.
cited_evidence: Every factory-run project x every merge not produced by a burst; compounds because the pipeline cannot tell its own output from foreign input, so unrecorded merges stay unfindable later (#819-class freeze integrity). || Integrity call is the load-bearing judgment: verify-sha-currency.sh DOES eventually raise a blocking signal at next session start, but the divergence itself is created silently at merge time and the signal names drift, not cause — and the green-CI-without-pipeline half is never signalled at all. Also the third member of the #510/#833/#835 contribution-governance family; the author flags it is not specifically an external-contributor problem (the maintainer out-of-band merge daac70dc is the generalizing case). Prohibited-repair trap worth surfacing: the natural fix is a hand-edit of STATE.md, the exact unowned write single-writer (#170) exists to prevent.

short_title: Factory lock has no visible holder and no handoff verb
quick_win_disqualification: Excluded twice over — attn.* items are never quick-win-eligible by rule (SKILL 3b), and the nature is design-architectural with an unverified premise (reproducibility unknown), not the mechanical end of the spectrum.
rationale: Rubric neutral allows "a study/observation request with no fix yet ... neutral-to-advances depending on whether it surfaces a real drift surface"; this surfaces one, so it resolves to advances. Evidence cited from the tracker rather than invented: #170's own reopening comment scoped S-17.01/02/03 and stated "This issue will be closed when the final story (S-17.03) merges", yet the issue closed ~3h later on 2026-06-11; and #732 (open, 2026-07-20) reports lock helpers invoked repo-relative so lock renew is unreachable in installed-plugin context. || CURATOR OVERRIDE: grader tagged attn.governance/reply-needed; declined. The facet's bar is prose that cannot survive summarisation, and this ask reduces without loss to two sentences. Reply-needed is carried as a Tier-1 control and a flag on the P2 row instead. Lane was also at the SKILL 7d ceiling of 7, where the skill directs tightening the bar. Follows the run-18 #823 precedent (grader-tagged, curator-declined, carried by its P2 row).
cited_evidence: Low visibility (coordination happens in chat today) x compounds with every additional operator; a dead session's lease is indistinguishable from a live colleague's, so recovery is always a human ask. || Graded pilot-derived despite no commit sha: the gap is an ABSENCE (no surface exists) which cannot be cited by sha, the triggering context is the same real two-contributor prism situation evidenced in #833, and the citations are concrete tracker artifacts with dates. Premise is explicitly unconfirmed — if S-17.03 did land, the correct outcome is a pointer, not a fix, so verify before working (task-workflow premise gate). Follow-on to #170; related #732, #273, #416.

short_title: Untrusted issue text reaching the spec layer
quick_win_disqualification: Design-architectural nature with no reproduction; SKILL 7a excludes the design/spec/directional end of the spectrum and this needs a human architectural ruling on the quarantine kind.
rationale: Rubric advances: "tightens an existing gate / removes a drift surface". #510 proposes external artifact content arriving as a linked issue; this names the trust boundary that flow opens — attacker-influenceable prose entering UPSTREAM of the adversarial cascade and landing in BCs that later agents treat as normative authority — and asks that #510's signed-branch provenance convention be made load-bearing rather than advisory. Speculative provenance does not route it to drifts: the drifts line requires "no observed failure AND no product-outcome path", and the product-outcome path is #510, which is live.
cited_evidence: Zero today (the flow is unbuilt) x unbounded if it ships unguarded — a poisoned BC is a durable instruction to every future agent on the project, not a one-off bad input. || Integrity=false is deliberate and should not be read as downgrading it: the fault described is PROSPECTIVE (the flow does not exist), so flagging it would dilute the meaning of the active-integrity flag. If #510's flow ships without a non-citable proposal kind, the resulting fault class WOULD be spec_process-tier integrity — a BC that disagrees with the project's real requirements with no signal. The named failure shape is the useful half: not obvious junk, but plausible well-formatted content that is subtly wrong (inverted EC condition, colliding error code, relaxed postcondition). Safety half of #510, spun out of #833.

short_title: No harvest path from ephemeral legion repos
quick_win_disqualification: Design-architectural and unowned — the one-field ask sounds bounded but its schema and writer are undecided, so the fix is not cited-and-obvious as 7a requires.
rationale: Rubric neutral: "a study/observation request with no fix yet ... neutral-to-advances depending on whether it surfaces a real drift surface". It does surface one — the factory spins off variants, mutates and discards them with no recorded question, so nothing can be harvested later by anyone including the author — but it cites no vsdd-factory commit, run, or lost finding, and the bulk of the body proposes machinery (three-tier taxonomy, dual index/knowledge stores, sampled harvest, adopt/integrate/reject dispositions) which the drifts line "proposes machinery before a concrete need (gradual-elaboration violation)" warns against. Net neutral; the minimal closing ask (one durable field recording the question a variant exists to answer) is the part that could advance.
cited_evidence: Invisible today (no user-facing surface) x compounds slowly as variant count and churn grow — each unharvested run is a permanently unrecoverable probe. || Adjacent to the manifest's learning-tier integrity anchor (adversarial findings / convergence history, "irreplaceable") but NOT flagged: it describes an absent capture path, not a fault destroying captured state, and no system of record claims the findings were kept. External model is real and in production on our side (aae-orc/_kos/ideas/three-tier-repo-taxonomy.md, i-orc/docs/repo-tiers.md) but those are our design docs, not a vsdd-factory reproduction — hence speculative. Corpus note for 4b: this is the one of the four whose body proposes machinery ahead of demonstrated need, an over_engineering_fingerprints candidate; recommend the curator engage only the cheap ask.
